description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (200.966) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (181.712) less the matching prior-year period (141.073).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 200.966，加本财年累计 181.712，减去上年同期累计 141.073。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Accelerating infrastructure costs absorb ad efficiency gains.
rationale.zh: 加快基建投入带来的成本侵蚀广告效率改善。

rationale.en: Advertising conversion improves as AI infrastructure spending rises.
rationale.zh: AI 基建开支上升的同时，广告转化率改善。

rationale.en: Ad volume and pricing both improve while new capacity earns returns.
rationale.zh: 广告量价齐升，同时新增算力产能开始贡献回报。
